symptom: The validation runner returned a PASS-shaped result without the required deterministic --record block and complete formal candidate manifest.
rootCause: The validation producer was still allowed to treat the formal record and manifest as prose output even though deterministic serializers existed.
correction: The validation skill, launcher prompts, runner adapters, contract checker, and serializer tests now require --manifest and byte-identical copying of deterministic record/manifest output before candidate validation or PASS.
